purpose: INSA v0.3 §5 Applicability Declaration for INSA-ID-E1. Per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-APPL-1, this declaration must be ACTIVE for State, Identity, and Evidence before any pre-execution gate passes.

state.rationale: INSA-ID-E1 exercises the Safe Evolution Contract (§12) which requires state-aware evolution: the executor must commit a consequential change against a frozen pre-mutation state, with freshness evidence captured at the M-commit boundary (INV-AUTH-5). State applies because the experiment is a controlled, state-mutating evolution of a governed intelligent executor against a frozen baseline.
state.evidence_artifact_pattern: runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/evidence-<N>.json (per-candidate evidence; created during Phase 1 generation)

identity.rationale: INSA-ID-E1's preservation model is built on identity-preservation gates (proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1, §5.2 subset-(a) and subset-(b)). The frozen baseline B (inputs/baseline-binding.json) content-addresses the identity contract as part of the baseline bundle. Identity applies because the experiment tests whether declared preservation dimensions are preserved under a targeted behavioral modification.
identity.evidence_artifact_pattern: subset-(a) and subset-(b) gates in inputs/preservation-gates.json

evidence.rationale: INSA-ID-E1 produces a per-step evidence profile (proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-EVID-1, §14 evidence-chain cross-cut) including locked evaluator scorebooks, raw candidate outputs, and causal-trace per §5.3. Evidence applies because architectural claim verification requires auditable, content-addressed evidence at every consequential step.

O_is_empty_attestation: O = ∅ (per proposal v5.1 §5.1); the BIB 4-dim vector (subset-(a)) + 8 C12 axes (subset-(b)) exhaust the scored dimensions tracked by the frozen evaluator rubric. Any candidate output dimension not in D = M ∪ P is unscored and therefore not a basis for any gate.
binding_completeness_attestation: All B + D + M + P + O + V(d) + A + G terms are content-addressed in MANIFEST.json. INV-D-1, INV-O-1, INV-P-1a, INV-P-1b, INV-V-1, INV-A-1, INV-G-1 all carry pre-mutation SHAs. INV-AUTH-1..5 captured in inputs/authority-manifest.json (static-only). INV-EVID-1 captured by content-addressing of all pre-execution artifacts. INV-APPL-1 satisfied by this declaration (State/Identity/Evidence ACTIVE). INV-STOP-1 references v0.1 C20 + BIB stop rules via protocol §15.

pi_adjudication.proposal_approval_artifact: Telegram approval at 2026-09-11 referencing proposal v5.1 SHA 1f84c3101d6add7d44ed821681946c10be8f5f5c
pi_adjudication.approval_scope: Protocol + frozen-artifact authoring per proposal v5.1. NOT execution authorization (separate Frank-as-PI GO required per proposal v5.1 §8).
